axes: reference-epoch heliocentric Galactic XYZ; screen Y = -Yg

coverageCatalog.note: Independent single-catalogue coverage avoids counting aliases from several catalogues as 100 distinct galaxies. Margin includes the self Milky Way entry and classification uncertainty; no spatial deduplication or membership is inferred.

pole: screen negative Y for Z >= 0; positive Y for Z < 0
notes: Distance domains override parent frames for centre positions: exact physical radius inside a frozen sphere; outside radius is at least 2a-a*a/r. Origin directions are Galactic longitude. Shapes follow their moved anchor. These fixed cartographic thresholds enclose at least the nearest 100 catalogue records and are not membership/halo boundaries. No catalogue-wide refit. Exact stellar catalogue positions take priority over the separate Alpha Centauri display orbit in this mode.
